$comment: The chunk budgets the R9 command registry ended with (2026-10-10), in bytes of each built chunk gzipped at level 9, read per lazy chunk: main is the entry chunk the home page runs, apps the app definitions it imports, home everything the home page loads statically; an app’s editor and its commands chunk load only when it opens (draw’s commands share a chunk with its editor’s imports), and open is all that opening it adds to the home page’s load. Merge base 51a71fb had main 40202, apps 168472, home 311717. R9-lints holds these: a build over a budget fails unless the budget is raised here with its reason.
